text:
Nina K: Proposing a small change: mark high-volume trace logs as 'ephemeral-30' and exclude from SIEM exports by default to reduce ingestion costs. Keep auth and diag events in SIEM.
Sam J: If we exclude them from SIEM, we lose central correlation. Could we instead downsample (1%) and keep full raw in cold store for 90d?
Priya M: Downsampling is reasonable, but we need to ensure we can rehydrate full data on request. Add a 'rehydrate' ticket workflow.
Nina K: Good idea. Add requirement: any rehydrate request must include a risk review if tenant is external.
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-3021 — "Trace downsample + rehydrate workflow" <https://redwood.internal/tickets/SEC-3021>
Nina K: Action items: Sam to prototype sampler; Priya to draft rehydrate runbook; sec-bot to add ticket reviewers.
